name: InterContinental Shanghai Wonderland
positioning: Luxury hotel built on the cliff face of an abandoned quarry 88 meters below sea level, in the Sheshan Tourism Resort of Songjiang, Shanghai, with underwater-view suites, a seafood restaurant below the water level and an indoor pool with waterfall views
best_for: Travelers who want a hotel built into a quarry
Guests who would like a suite with an underwater view
Families heading to the nearby Smurfs theme park at Shimao Fairy City

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as the world's first luxury hotel built inside a quarry.
The hotel sits in the Sheshan Tourism Resort of Songjiang, Shanghai.
The hotel is 40 minutes from the Shanghai National Exhibition and Convention Center.
The lobby has a Subterranean Adventure theme, with bronze-colored walls that reproduce the layers of quarry rock.
Guest rooms have a 55-inch LCD TV, a JBL sound system, a separate shower and bathtub, and Dyson hair dryers.
The Duplex Suite may include an outdoor living area and an underwater view.
The hotel's spa, Sheng Spa, offers hydrotherapy.
From the She Shan Lounge Lobby Bar, guests can take in the Sheshan National Scenic Area and the deep pits of Tianma Mountain.
The Quarry Bar sits between the bottom of the quarry and the water.
The Smurfs theme park at Shimao Fairy City is about 0.6 kilometers from the hotel.

highlights.text: The hotel is built on the cliff face of an abandoned quarry 88 meters below sea level.
The Underwater View Suite may include an underwater view and a balcony.
The indoor pool offers views of the waterfall.
Mr. Fisher, a seafood restaurant one floor below the water level, is surrounded by a custom-built display of swimming sea creatures.

considerations.text: Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport is about 29.9 kilometers from the hotel.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the location is remote, outside central Shanghai.
